selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What two things does the truth of Mercifulness show in this passage?
questions.answer: It shows Allah’s unity and His oneness within that unity.

questions.question: Which beings are cared for by this mercy in the passage?
questions.answer: All living creatures are cared for, especially the new ones that have just come into life.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the way mercy cares for living things?
questions.answer: It cares for them in a very organized and balanced way.

questions.question: What reaches living beings because of this mercy?
questions.answer: The things they need reach them.

questions.question: What does the passage say mercy does not do when giving needs?
questions.answer: It does not leave any of them out.

questions.question: When does this mercy reach individuals?
questions.answer: It reaches them all at the same time.

questions.question: What special group is mentioned to help us notice mercy more clearly?
questions.answer: Newly created living beings are specially mentioned.

questions.question: What happened to the traveler after seeing this truth?
questions.answer: He witnessed the Third Truth in the Third Stopping-Place.

questions.question: What is being compared to the truth of Mercifulness at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: It is compared to the truth of Opening, which also proves unity clearly.

questions.question: In what way is the truth of Opening similar to the truth of Mercifulness?
questions.answer: Both are said to prove unity in a very clear way.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the forms of beings in the truth of Opening?
questions.answer: Their forms are made and unfolded in a regular and orderly way.

questions.question: What does the truth of Mercifulness include or cover?
questions.answer: It covers all things.

questions.question: What part of life is focused on in this mercy?
questions.answer: It focuses on caring for living beings when they come into this world.

questions.question: Which living beings are given extra attention in the wording of the passage?
questions.answer: Those that are newly arrived in life are especially pointed out.

questions.question: How carefully are the needs of living beings provided?
questions.answer: They are provided with great order, and none are missed.

questions.question: What does mercy reaching every individual everywhere at once teach us?
questions.answer: It teaches that the source of mercy is one and fully in control of all.

questions.question: How are animate beings described when they begin life in this world?
questions.answer: They are described as coming into existence and entering worldly life.

questions.question: What does the passage say happens to the needs of living beings?
questions.answer: Their needs are delivered to them.

questions.question: How complete is this care?
questions.answer: It is complete enough that no individual is forgotten.

questions.question: What word in the passage shows that this mercy is not limited to one place?
questions.answer: It says mercy reaches individuals everywhere.

questions.question: What word in the passage shows that this mercy is not limited by time delays?
questions.answer: It says mercy reaches them at the same instant.

questions.question: If all creatures are cared for in the same perfect way, what does that suggest about the One caring for them?
questions.answer: It suggests that He is one, and His care covers all creation together.

questions.question: What does “oneness within unity” mean here in a simple way?
questions.answer: It means one Lord is dealing with all creatures together while His care reaches each one.

questions.question: What two beliefs are supported by these signs of mercy?
questions.answer: Belief in divine unity and oneness within unity.
